thread:
anya: Quick note from today's feedback session: admins struggle to find which roles have audit access. The matrix buries that column in condensed views.
mike: Good call. We could pin a small 'audit' pill left of the role name for rows where audit_view=true so it's immediately visible.
carmen: +1. For keyboard users the pill needs to be focusable and have a clear aria-label like 'Audit access enabled for Role X'.
rohan: Invite flow copy also caused confusion when SSO is required. Current line: `Invites will use your org SSO.` People read that as optional.
anya: Draft alternative: "SSO required: invited users will sign in with your identity provider
nd will not create a separate password." Thoughts?
mike: Prefer dropping 'separate' maybe: 'will not create a password' reads direct.
carmen: Add a tiny inline helper link 'How SSO works' that opens a short modal with bullets and example screenshots; ensure modal heading structure is screen-reader friendly.
rohan: Also suggested: a visible knob that toggles row density with a live preview next to it labeled 'Preview: Comfort | Compact' so admins can see impact before switching.
anya: Accessibility checklist from eng-bot?
eng-bot: Checklist: 1) pinned audit pill: tabindex=0, aria-label per role; 2) density toggle: update focus order, announce change with aria-live polite; 3) chevrons that expand advanced perms: use aria-expanded and aria-controls; 4) invite modal: ensure focus trap and escape closes.
mike: Small UI nit: make the audit pill high-contrast (border + bg) and 40px min touch target.
carmen: Action items: Mike to mock audit pill + preview; Rohan to refine SSO microcopy and modal copy; Anya to add a11y requirements to the PR template; Eng to include aria attributes and feature flag note.
rohan: I'll run the microcopy with 6 admins tomorrow.
anya: Thanks everyone. Sync briefly after standup?
eng-bot: Reminder: update feature-flags.json for the row-density flag.
anya: Great, saving notes to the design doc now. :sparkles:
